en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a seaside fortress complex on a rocky peninsula, with fortified walls, bastions and buildings stretching along the waterfront. Calm blue water fills the foreground and a sailboat is visible in the bay. Trees and greenery crown the hilltop defenses. At the top left in red lettering appears the title in French and Greek, and at the bottom right a faint website watermark is visible.
